title: Knock Sensor Detection System (KSDS) - Engine Limp Home Mode
meaning: Knock Sensor Detection System (KSDS) algorithm detected abnormal high-frequency engine vibration frequencies characteristic of severe connecting rod bearing wear / clearance play (Technical Service Bulletin 21-01-052H). ECM forced vehicle into 1,800-2,000 RPM Limp-Home Mode.
symptoms: Flashing Check Engine Light (MIL)
Engine throttled to limp-home mode (max 1800-2000 RPM)
Audible bottom-end rod bearing knock under light acceleration
Loss of acceleration and passing power on highway
inspectionSteps: DO NOT clear code before documenting freeze frame data for Hyundai/Kia extended engine warranty claim (Campaign 953 / T3G).
Perform Hyundai/Kia Bearing Clearance Test (BCT) using factory SST or specialized acoustic tool.
Inspect engine oil level, oil filter condition, and check oil pan for bronze/metallic bearing glitter.
Verify knock sensor resistance and wiring harness sub-assembly near starter motor.
verifiedFixes: Complete engine short-block or long-block replacement under Hyundai/Kia extended lifetime bearing warranty
Update ECM KSDS software calibration and replace knock sensor wiring harness if bearing clearance test passes

title: Continuous Variable Valve Timing (CVVT) - Intake Cam Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
meaning: Intake camshaft timing angle has exceeded target advance threshold on Theta II / Gamma GDI engine, typically caused by sludged Oil Control Valve (OCV) or stuck camshaft phaser.
symptoms: Illuminated Check Engine Light
Rough engine idle and hesitation on cold starts
Rattling or clicking noise from front timing cover during startup
Decreased fuel economy
inspectionSteps: Check engine oil level and viscosity; low or sheared 5W-20/5W-30 oil starves CVVT phasers.
Remove and inspect Intake Oil Control Valve (OCV) spool and micro-mesh screen for carbon varnish.
Bench test OCV solenoid resistance (approx. 6.8 to 8.2 ohms) and 12V actuation.
verifiedFixes: Replace faulty Intake Camshaft Oil Control Valve (OCV)
Engine oil flush with genuine Hyundai/Kia OEM oil filter and fresh synthetic oil
Replace worn intake CVVT camshaft gear phaser assembly

title: Continuous Variable Valve Timing (CVVT) - Exhaust Cam Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
meaning: Exhaust camshaft position is more advanced than commanded by the ECM due to oil pressure starvation, sticking exhaust OCV solenoid, or timing chain elongation.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Engine stumbling or stalling when coming to a stop
Rough idle when warm
Pungent exhaust odor
inspectionSteps: Remove and clean Exhaust Oil Control Valve (OCV) on cylinder head.
Inspect timing chain tensioner extension and check for stretched timing chain slack.
Verify oil pressure at cylinder head port with mechanical pressure gauge.
verifiedFixes: Replace Exhaust Oil Control Valve (OCV)
Replace timing chain, tensioner arms, and hydraulic tensioner
Fresh engine oil service with OEM filter

title: EVAP System Gross Leak Detected
meaning: ECM vacuum decay monitor detected large vapor flow loss in fuel evaporative system during engine-off natural vacuum (EONV) test.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Fuel odor near rear quarter panel / fuel door
Occasional hard starting immediately after refueling at gas station
inspectionSteps: Inspect fuel filler cap O-ring seal for tears, cracks, or loose ratchet fit.
Inspect Canister Close Valve (CCV) vent solenoid mounted near charcoal canister above rear suspension.
Perform EVAP smoke test through engine bay service port.
verifiedFixes: Replace faulty Canister Close Valve (CCV) vent solenoid
Replace genuine fuel filler cap
Replace cracked charcoal vapor canister assembly

title: EVAP System Very Small Leak Detected (0.020 inch)
meaning: Micro-leak detected in evaporative fuel system during precision pressure decay cycle.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Emissions monitor fails to set ready
inspectionSteps: Smoke test fuel vapor lines with ultrasonic leak detector.
Verify PCSV solenoid seal against manifold vacuum.
Inspect fuel tank pressure sensor (FTPS) signal stability.
verifiedFixes: Replace Purge Control Solenoid Valve (PCSV)
Replace fuel cap with OEM replacement
Replace leaking Canister Close Valve (CCV)

title: High Pressure Fuel System - Pressure Low
meaning: High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) driven by camshaft lobe failed to deliver commanded rail pressure under high load.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Engine sputtering or going flat above 3500 RPM
Long cranking time before starting
Vehicle enters reduced power mode
inspectionSteps: Monitor live high-pressure fuel rail sensor PID during wide-open throttle test.
Remove mechanical HPFP from valve cover and inspect tappet roller follower for wear against camshaft lobe.
Test low-pressure in-tank fuel pump delivery (approx. 5-6 bar supply).
verifiedFixes: Replace mechanical High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP)
Replace worn HPFP roller tappet follower and exhaust camshaft if scored
Replace in-tank low pressure fuel delivery pump

title: Motor Driven Power Steering (MDPS) - Torque Sensor Error
meaning: Electronic Power Steering (MDPS) ECU detected abnormal voltage differential across steering column optical/magnetic torque sensor coils.
symptoms: Steering wheel icon warning light illuminated on cluster
Heavy manual steering effort (power assist abruptly cut)
Notchy or clicking feeling when turning steering wheel
inspectionSteps: Perform MDPS ASP (Absolute Steering Position) calibration zero-point relearn.
Inspect steering column flexible rubber coupling (star coupler) for disintegration/slop.
Check torque sensor harness connector under lower dash panel.
verifiedFixes: Calibrate Absolute Steering Position (ASP) with diagnostic tool
Replace steering column flexible rubber coupler (Service Campaign 14-ST-002)
Replace steering column MDPS torque sensor assembly

title: Driver Airbag Resistance High (1st Stage) - Clockspring Failure
meaning: SRS Airbag Control Module detected squib circuit resistance exceeding 3.5 ohms in the driver's steering wheel airbag circuit, typically caused by broken ribbon tape in the clockspring.
symptoms: Airbag warning light illuminated constantly
Steering wheel horn or cruise control buttons intermittently inoperative
Audible rubbing or clicking noise when rotating steering wheel
inspectionSteps: DISCONNECT BATTERY AND WAIT 5 MINUTES before servicing steering wheel SRS system.
Measure clockspring ribbon continuity while turning steering wheel lock-to-lock.
Inspect yellow SRS squib connector behind airbag module.
verifiedFixes: Replace steering column Clockspring assembly (contact coil)
Repair damaged steering column airbag sub-harness connector
